Halstead Instruments

THE STUDIO IS OPEN. We restore and calibrate laboratory balances, and hold the only remaining stock of knife edges for the Oertling range.

Calibration is UKAS-traceable and certificates are issued the same week. Turnaround on a restoration is eight to twelve weeks depending on what we find once the case is open.
